prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [adoption, redesign] Carousel Layout Pet Selection Redesign: Redesign the pet pick screen using a carousel layout featuring large interactive pet preview components.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "carousel", "components": [{"type": "preview", "asset": "asset:pet_preview_carousel", "style": "large"}, {"type": "button", "label": "Choose This Pet", "action": "choose", "style": "playful"}]}}
1: [sign_in, reorder] Reorder Sign-In After Pet Adoption: Move the sign-in screen to occur after pet selection and adoption certificate step, right before pet generation starts.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "sign_in", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
2: [home, redesign] Full Bleed Waiting Screen Redesign: Redesign the waiting screen into a full bleed layout with an integrated tip carousel component and timer display.
   config: {"waiting": {"layout": "full_bleed", "show_time_estimate": true, "components": [{"type": "tip_carousel", "text": "Tips while your pet is generating", "style": "calm"}, {"type": "timer", "style": "subtle"}]}}
3: [finish, redesign] Split View Home Welcome Screen Redesign: Rebuild the home_intro welcome screen using a split layout displaying the mascot side-by-side with getting started actions.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "split", "components": [{"type": "mascot", "asset": "asset:desktop_mascot", "style": "playful"}, {"type": "button", "label": "Start Exploring", "action": "next", "style": "emphasis"}]}}
4: [adoption, new_screen] Pre-Generation Adoption Summary Screen: Insert a new summary screen right before pet generation to review selected pet traits and photo uploads.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "new_adoption_summary", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_adoption_summary": {"headline": "Confirm Pet Details", "body": "Review your photo choices and traits before your desktop pet is created.", "layout": "centered", "button_label": "Generate My Pet"}}
5: [home, notification] Notification Toggle on Pet Ready: Enable desktop notification switch on the waiting screen to alert users when their pet generation finishes.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "hint": "We will notify you on your desktop as soon as your pet is ready!"}}
6: [choose_path, redesign] Card Layout Story Intro Redesign: Redesign the story intro screen to a card layout featuring an animated desktop pet mascot component.
   config: {"story": {"layout": "card", "components": [{"type": "mascot", "asset": "asset:intro_mascot", "style": "playful"}]}}
7: [adoption, hint] Photo Quality Tip Guidance: Add photo quality guidance hints and visual preview guides on the upload_photos screen.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"hint": "Use clear, well-lit frontal photos for best pet generation results.", "components": [{"type": "preview", "asset": "asset:photo_guide", "style": "subtle"}]}}
8: [sign_in, copy] Account Reconnection Clarification Copy: Update sign-in headline and body copy to clarify that existing pets and progress will be safely synced upon signing in.
   config: {"sign_in": {"headline": "Sign In to Sync & Restore Your Pet", "body": "Log into your account to keep your pet saved safely and sync existing pets to this desktop.", "button_label": "Sign In to Sync"}}
9: [adoption, incentive] Adoption Completion Badge Incentive: Display progress indicators and an official pet adoption badge component on the adoption certificate screen.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"show_progress": true, "components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "style": "highlight"}]}}

verdicts.reason: Redesigns pet selection into a carousel while preserving pet choice functionality.
Reordering sign-in after adoption certificate is explicitly permitted by Rule 4.
Redesigns waiting screen with a real timer and tips without violating fair design rules.
Redesigns home_intro layout inside onboarding bounds.
Adds a new summary screen inside onboarding without removing or skipping required steps.
Adds desktop notification toggle on waiting screen as allowed by Rule 4.
Redesigns story screen into a card layout while still introducing the pet.
Adds guidance hints and guides to photo upload screen without violating rules.
Updates sign-in copy within onboarding without mentioning pricing or breaking rules.
Adds progress indicators and official badge to certificate screen while maintaining official stamp representation.
